understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate through every level and activate all goal cells. A goal activates only when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal’s requirements, then the piece must move onto the goal cell. All goals must be completed to advance and ultimately win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one grid step at a time using directional actions. Walls block movement but still consume stamina. Modifier tiles alter the carried piece: shape modifiers cycle its shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. The piece’s attributes must be managed while navigating to the appropriate goal. Stamina decreases with actions; reaching zero costs a life and resets stamina. Losing all lives ends the game. In this episode, the remaining goal required changing the rotation from 270° to 0° by reaching the rotation modifier at [19,30], but the goal was not completed before the episode ended.
